verdict.rationale: Weaviate's pricing page advertises an always-free cloud cluster (one per user) with the option to upgrade to paid at any time. Prototyping at no cost is also possible because Weaviate is open source and runs locally via Docker or as an embedded Python package, which a community user calls fairly easy to get running. Missing for 10: documented limits of the free cluster (storage, object count, duration), and independent corroboration that the free cloud tier is meaningful for real prototyping.
